skill.name: Next.js Better Auth Integration
skill.description: Guides conceptual Better Auth integration with the Next.js App Router, including sessions, JWTs, protected routes, and security considerations.
skill.summary: Plan Better Auth sessions and protected routes for a Next.js App Router application.
skill.author: Claude

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The referenced text describes server-side session access in Next.js and contains no network reconnaissance instruction or executable behavior. No prompt injection, data-exfiltration intent, or other semantic security concern was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - Use server components for server-side session access

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md lines 122-123 recommend server components for server-side session access and client components for authentication UI. This is standard Next.js architecture guidance and does not direct network discovery or scanning.

content.value_statement: Setting up authentication with the App Router requires coordinated session, middleware, and component decisions. This skill provides a structured conceptual checklist for planning a Better Auth integration.
actual_capabilities: Outlines Better Auth initialization, provider configuration, and adapter planning.
Explains JWT expiration, refresh, signing, and validation considerations.
Describes session access patterns for server and client components.
Covers middleware-based protected routes and unauthorized redirects.
Provides security, performance, testing, and error-handling checklists.
limitations: This is conceptual guidance and does not generate a complete application implementation.
It does not provide package installation commands or version-specific Better Auth APIs.
Database schema, provider credentials, and deployment configuration require project-specific decisions.
Security controls must be tested and reviewed for the deployed environment.

use_cases.title: Plan an App Router migration
use_cases.description: Map session context, middleware, and protected pages before adding Better Auth to an App Router application.

use_cases.title: Review authentication architecture
use_cases.description: Check proposed JWT, cookie, session invalidation, and route protection decisions against the skill guidance.

use_cases.title: Create an authentication test plan
use_cases.description: Build tests for sign-in, expiration, protected routes, provider integration, and authentication error states.

prompt_templates.title: Identify integration steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list the main steps for adding Better Auth to my Next.js App Router application.

prompt_templates.title: Plan protected routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to propose a plan for protecting these App Router paths: [list paths]. Include middleware and server-side checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review session design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my proposed session design. I use [cookie or JWT approach], [providers], and [database adapter]. Identify missing security controls.

prompt_templates.title: Create a verification checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a detailed test checklist for Better Auth in a Next.js App Router application with [providers] and [protected routes].

output: Server-side session checks for each page.

output_examples.input: Review JWT session security for my application.
output: Checklist for secure cookie settings and token handling.
Recommendations for expiration, refresh, validation, and invalidation.
Test cases for expired and invalid sessions.

best_practices: Store session secrets securely and never expose them to client components.
Use secure, HTTP-only cookies and validate authentication on the server.
Test route protection, session expiration, and recovery flows before release.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this conceptual skill as a substitute for current Better Auth documentation.
Do not store session tokens in insecure client-side storage.
Do not rely only on client-side checks to protect sensitive routes.

faq.question: Does this skill install Better Auth?
faq.answer: No. It provides conceptual integration guidance and planning checklists.

faq.question: Which Next.js router does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Next.js App Router patterns, including middleware and server components.

faq.question: Does it include complete source code?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes implementation areas without providing a complete codebase.

faq.question: Can it help protect routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines middleware, server-side checks, and unauthenticated redirect behavior.

faq.question: Does it support social login planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes social provider integration as an authentication flow consideration.

faq.question: How should I handle secrets?
faq.answer: Store them in a secure environment configuration and keep them out of client-side code.
